Method of Attack: Bypass Controlled Folder Access (CFA) feature in Windows 10 via Office OLE objects
Use of boobytrapped Office documents with scripts to overwrite, password-protect, or copy-paste and encrypt files inside CFA folders
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 with Controlled Folder Access enabled
Attack Vector: Malicious Office documents received via spam email
Date of Discovery: October 2017 (CFA feature introduction), research published over the weekend (relative to article date)
